    StartersOlives and fetaMarinated feta and olives with lemon, oregano and crusty breadHow to make it200g feta, cubed200g mixed olives80ml olive oil1 lemon, zested1 tsp dried oreganopinch of chilli flakes1 crusty loaf, slicedMix the feta with the olives, oil, lemon zest, oregano and chilli.Leave at room temperature to marinate.Serve with the sliced crusty loaf.Medieval turkey legsBrined roast turkey drumsticks glazed with honey and wholegrain mustardHow to make it80g sea salt80g brown sugar2 L water4 turkey drumsticks3 tbsp honey2 tbsp wholegrain mustardDissolve the salt and sugar in the water and brine the drumsticks overnight in the fridge.Pat the drumsticks dry.Roast at 160°C for most of the cooking time.Mix the honey and mustard, brush over and roast until glazed.San Dimas mall cinnamon pretzel bitesThe history class field trip to the San Dimas mallHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft pretzel bites baked deep brown, rolled in butter and cinnamon sugar, with a sweet cream cheese icing dip, straight from a food court stall.Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour.Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites.Dip in 2 litres boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds and bake at 220°C for 12 minutes.Toss in 50g melted butter, then 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.Beat 100g cream cheese with 80g icing sugar and 2 tbsp milk for the dip.Beef taquitos with salsaRufus approves. Be excellent to each other.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsNapoleon's chicken MarengoChicken thighs braised with mushrooms, tomato and white wine, crusty breadHow to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets2 tbsp olive oil1 onion, diced3 garlic cloves, crushed200g button mushrooms, sliced125ml white wine400g diced tomatoes (1 tin)1 small bunch parsley1 baguetteBrown the chicken in the oil in batches and set aside.Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.Add the mushrooms, wine and tomatoes.Return the chicken, cover and simmer.Scatter with parsley and serve with the baguette.Socrates' chicken souvlaki, Greek saladSocrates, picked up in ancient AthensHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lemon, garlic and oregano chicken skewers grilled until charred, in warm pita with tzatziki, beside a chunky Greek salad with a slab of feta.Cube 800g chicken thighs and marinate 1 hour in 3 tbsp olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tsp dried oregano.Thread onto 8 skewers and grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning.Grate 1 cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 200g Greek yoghurt, garlic and dill.Chop 3 tomatoes, the rest of a cucumber, half a red onion and 1 green capsicum with olives, top with 150g feta, oregano and oil.Warm 4 pita.SweetsSan Dimas mall sundaeBananas with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, whipped cream, sauceHow to make it4 bananas500ml vanilla ice cream500ml chocolate ice cream500ml strawberry ice cream300ml thickened cream100ml chocolate sauce2 tbsp sprinkles50g mixed nuts, chopped4 maraschino cherriesSplit the bananas and line a long dish.Add scoops of the three ice creams down the middle.Whip the cream.Pile on cream, chocolate sauce, sprinkles, nuts and cherries.
